decisions.claim: B is in the same city as A
decisions.reason: 'our city' presupposes both A and B share the same city; this is a necessary presupposition of the possessive.

decisions.claim: B is asked to draw up a schedule for the Smiths
decisions.reason: Direct request 'Can you draw up a schedule for them?' explicitly tasks B with this action.

decisions.claim: B is associated with a factory
decisions.reason: 'our factory' presupposes B is associated with the factory mentioned by A.

decisions.claim: B is part of a company that has designers
decisions.reason: 'our designers' presupposes B belongs to a company that employs designers.

decisions.claim: B is part of a company
decisions.reason: 'our company' presupposes B is part of the company referenced.

decisions.claim: A instructs B to pay more attention
decisions.reason: 'you need to pay more attention' is a direct instruction to B.

decisions.claim: B is asked to work out an efficient schedule
decisions.reason: 'Try to work out an efficient schedule' is a direct request to B.

decisions.claim: B works at the same company as A
decisions.reason: 'our company' presupposes shared membership between A and B in the same company.

decisions.claim: B is tasked with drawing up a schedule for the Smiths' visit
decisions.reason: Combines c2 and c7 into a single claim about the same task (drawing up a schedule for the Smiths' visit); bidirectionally equivalent to c2 at this granularity.

decisions.claim: B is expected to pay special attention to the Smiths' visit
decisions.reason: Rephrases c6 ('A instructs B to pay more attention') as 'B is expected to pay special attention'; same event and property.

decisions.claim: B's company has a factory that produces computer products
decisions.reason: 'our factory and have a look at the new type computer products' presupposes B's company has a factory producing computer products.
Rephrases c4 ('B is part of a company that has designers') as 'B's company employs designers'; bidirectionally equivalent.

design: dual route, targeted rescue, globally grouped evidence adjudication
